title: Your Model Is Unfair, Are You Even Aware? Inverse Relationship Between Comprehension and Trust in Explainability Visualizations of Biased ML Models
benchmark_measurement: This paper did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The study focused on comprehension, trust, and perception of bias (related to sex and age) in machine learning model explanations.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of the study.
